coverage_gaps: EMA and other non-US regulatory routes are unavailable, so international regulatory differences cannot be systematically assessed.
Embase, Scopus, Web of Science, preprint servers, and dedicated citation-graph services are unavailable, limiting conference, unindexed, preprint, and forward-citation recall.
Publisher-platform and Crossref routes are unavailable, so a correction or retraction posted outside PubMed may require later verification.
Proprietary claims and disease-registry databases are unavailable as direct routes; qualifying real-world evidence is limited to records indexed in PubMed.
ClinicalTrials.gov may expose a current record view; historical version dates must be used to prevent post-cutoff registry information from entering the assessment.
Full-text availability is unspecified, so some methods, adjudication definitions, subgroup estimates, and correction details may remain abstract- or metadata-limited.
exclusion_criteria: Preclinical, animal, in vitro, or mechanistic-only studies without direct relevance to marketed clinical safety.
Efficacy-only studies lacking cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, mortality, or regulatory-safety information.
Studies confined to non-RA indications unless they directly explain an FDA action, marketed dose restriction, or cross-indication label consequence originating from the RA safety trial.
Narrative commentary, news coverage, or unsourced opinion when the underlying primary study, registry record, or regulator document is available.
Duplicate bibliographic records after canonical identifier matching, while preserving every query-to-record occurrence and study-family link.
Records first published, posted, updated, or made effective after 2024-12-31.
Reports that combine JAK inhibitors without separable tofacitinib evidence relevant to the decision.
Interim or secondary reports that duplicate the primary analysis without adding a distinct outcome, population, follow-up interval, correction, or interpretation-relevant limitation.
inclusion_criteria: Human studies of adults with rheumatoid arthritis receiving marketed tofacitinib doses or directly relevant dose comparisons.
The NCT02092467 registry record, its version history through the cutoff, posted results, adverse-event tables, and linked publications.
The primary ORAL Surveillance publication and secondary analyses that directly inform cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, or mortality findings.
Official FDA safety communications, prescribing-information revisions, boxed warnings, and use limitations triggered by or explicitly connected to the postauthorization trial.
Comparative observational, registry, or claims-based evidence that can qualify, corroborate, or conflict with the pivotal trial findings.
Evidence reporting usable outcome definitions, comparator details, dose, follow-up, effect estimates, uncertainty, or absolute event counts.
Corrections, errata, expressions of concern, retractions, and publication-status notices linked to included records.
Records published, posted, updated, or made effective on or before 2024-12-31, with online-first, issue, registry-update, and regulatory-action dates recorded separately.
English-language records or official English FDA and ClinicalTrials.gov records with sufficient metadata for study-family linkage.

queries.purpose: Recover the pivotal registry anchor and capture official title, sponsor study number, eligibility, randomized arms and doses, endpoints, dates, results, adverse-event tables, update history, and linked publications.
Validate study aliases and recover the registry-linked primary publication plus indexed secondary analyses.
queries.query: ("NCT02092467"[All Fields] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "A3921133"[All Fields]) AND (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Recover FDA pages that explicitly identify the required postmarketing trial and connect its findings to regulatory action.
queries.query: tofacitinib Xeljanz NCT02092467 "ORAL Surveillance" safety trial

queries.purpose: Maximize recall for peer-reviewed RA safety evidence across all four decision-critical outcome families through the cutoff.
queries.query: (("Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[MeSH Terms] OR "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Tofacitinib"[MeSH Terms] OR tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract] OR "CP-690550"[Title/Abstract] OR "CP-690,550"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Cardiovascular Diseases"[MeSH Terms] OR "major adverse cardiovascular events"[Title/Abstract] OR MACE[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR thrombosis[Title/Abstract] OR thromboembol*[Title/Abstract] OR "pulmonary embolism"[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract])) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Recover the primary ORAL Surveillance publication by exact title or PMID and verify study identifiers, design, estimands, outcome definitions, effect estimates, follow-up, and funding.
queries.query: "Cardiovascular and Cancer Risk with Tofacitinib in Rheumatoid Arthritis"[Title] OR "35081280"[PMID]

queries.purpose: Recover the February 2019 alert and subsequent 2019 boxed-warning action concerning pulmonary embolism and mortality at the 10 mg twice-daily dose, preserving action and effective dates.
queries.query: tofacitinib Xeljanz "safety trial finds risk of blood clots in the lungs and death" 2019

queries.purpose: Recover the 2021 preliminary and final FDA communications and linked label changes, including the affected populations, comparator, risk conclusions, prescribing limitations, and action dates.
queries.query: tofacitinib Xeljanz "increased risk of serious heart-related events, cancer, blood clots, and death" 2021 boxed warning

queries.purpose: Seek cardiovascular null, conflicting, external-validity, subgroup, and real-world evidence that may qualify the pivotal trial finding.
queries.query: ((tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND ("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] OR "Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[MeSH Terms]) AND ("major adverse cardiovascular events"[Title/Abstract] OR MACE[Title/Abstract] OR myocardial infarction[Title/Abstract] OR stroke[Title/Abstract]) AND (observational[Title/Abstract] OR registry[Title/Abstract] OR claims[Title/Abstract] OR "real-world"[Title/Abstract] OR "TNF inhibitor"[Title/Abstract] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "STAR-RA"[Title/Abstract])) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Seek malignancy null, conflicting, latency-related, subtype-specific, subgroup, and real-world evidence that may qualify the pivotal trial finding.
queries.query: ((tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND ("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] OR "Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[MeSH Terms]) AND (malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR lymphoma[Title/Abstract] OR "lung cancer"[Title/Abstract] OR "nonmelanoma skin cancer"[Title/Abstract]) AND (observational[Title/Abstract] OR registry[Title/Abstract] OR claims[Title/Abstract] OR "real-world"[Title/Abstract] OR "TNF inhibitor"[Title/Abstract] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract])) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Seek dose-specific thrombosis analyses, negative or conflicting studies, risk-factor analyses, and real-world comparisons.
queries.query: ((tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND ("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] OR "Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[MeSH Terms]) AND (thrombosis[Title/Abstract] OR thromboembol*[Title/Abstract] OR "venous thromboembolism"[Title/Abstract] OR "pulmonary embolism"[Title/Abstract] OR "deep vein thrombosis"[Title/Abstract]) AND (dose[Title/Abstract] OR observational[Title/Abstract] OR registry[Title/Abstract] OR claims[Title/Abstract] OR "real-world"[Title/Abstract] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract])) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Expand from the anchor study to linked secondary analyses that explain effect modification, absolute risk, susceptible populations, outcome adjudication, and interpretation.
queries.query: ("NCT02092467"[All Fields] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "A3921133"[All Fields]) AND (subgroup[Title/Abstract] OR "risk factor"[Title/Abstract] OR biomarker[Title/Abstract] OR incidence[Title/Abstract] OR "number needed to harm"[Title/Abstract] OR post hoc[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Check for FDA label revisions, safety communications, or enforcement-relevant updates after the pivotal action and through the cutoff.
queries.query: tofacitinib Xeljanz rheumatoid arthritis safety communication boxed warning prescribing information label 2022 2023 2024

queries.purpose: Check for related registered safety studies and registry updates that contextualize or extend NCT02092467; retain only versions and events dated on or before the cutoff.
queries.query: "rheumatoid arthritis" AND (tofacitinib OR "CP-690550") AND (cardiovascular OR malignancy OR thrombosis OR mortality)

question_frame: Safety PECO and regulatory-evidence frame: adults with rheumatoid arthritis, emphasizing patients aged 50 years or older with at least one cardiovascular risk factor; marketed tofacitinib 5 mg or 10 mg twice daily compared with tumor necrosis factor inhibitors or relevant real-world comparators; assess major adverse cardiovascular events, malignancy, venous or arterial thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, and all-cause or cardiovascular mortality through 2024-12-31; connect the pivotal postauthorization study to its registry record, primary publication, secondary analyses, and dated FDA actions, while identifying qualifying or conflicting evidence and publication corrections, expressions of concern, or retractions that alter evidence handling.
stop_rules: Execute all 16 planned query events across the three selected routes and record the exact query, execution timestamp, cutoff handling, result count, and provider version when available.

Recover and cross-link NCT02092467, sponsor study A3921133, the primary publication identified by PMID 35081280, and the FDA communications or label actions from 2019 and 2021; unresolved identity mismatches trigger escalation.

For each of cardiovascular events, malignancy, thrombosis, and mortality, recover the primary ORAL Surveillance evidence and complete its distinct challenge query for null, conflicting, subgroup, or external-validity evidence.
Complete the correction, erratum, expression-of-concern, and retraction search and verify publication status on every included high-impact PubMed record through the cutoff.
Complete the PubMed, FDA, and ClinicalTrials.gov update waves through 2024-12-31 and separate publication, online-first, registry-update, and regulatory effective dates.
Stop citation or linked-record expansion after two consecutive completed expansion passes add no new decision-relevant study family, regulatory action, correction, or outcome estimate.

Stop when further retrieval cannot change the direction, certainty, population qualification, dose interpretation, regulatory chronology, or publication-integrity handling for any decision-critical outcome.

If the 16-event budget is exhausted before all anchors and outcome challenge branches are resolved, preserve completed events, report the unresolved branches as coverage gaps, and do not infer missing evidence.
Merge canonical records by stable identifiers while retaining all query-to-record links; conflicting duplicates remain unresolved and are excluded from synthesis pending adjudication.
